body.for: any runner with a Mistral key: this container, or a visitor's browser (run.html)
body.title: Storm-six rerun on 4 Mistral models
body.story: A rerun of the PrompTugal Swarm's storm-six packets (s001 and s002, 11 November 2026: four open-weight models through OpenRouter) with the same prompt, check and consensus, on Mistral models only, direct to Mistral's API.

source.workload: the storm site's datasets, read over its public API

body.mandate: Read the six storm datasets and answer each task's question, checked, on each named Mistral model. Nothing else.
body.output: site/data/swarm/runs/<id>--<runner>.json, signed by a key made for the run
